calibration.scope: controlled evidence-relative development calibration; no real-dialogue accuracy claim

E2.central_controller: One reviewer with persistent review history and current state; all raw evidence and identical initial verifier feedback.
E2.peer_primary: Frozen initial claims; cross-owner reviewers; no sequential peer-state propagation.
E2.new_claim_verifier_access: All feedback-enabled methods may verify newly generated claims within the same budget ceiling.
E2.budget_policy: Same ceiling; actual calls and tokens reported. Shared production and verification charged to every consuming path; no claim of equal actual spend.

E3.no_runtime_verifier: No initial feedback, no semantic calls; model-requested operations retain only structural scope validation, and unchecked claims never become certified supported.
E3.no_scope_constraint: Reuse peer_matched, which rewrites whole owner reports; no extra calls or independent sample claim.
E3.force_binary: Same verifier feedback, but insufficient is forced to keep/retract; forced_from_insufficient is explicitly logged.

artifact_controls: shared initial and feedback integrity hash
claim-hash binding prevents feedback reuse on rewritten claims
explicit rejected proposal and whole-report change logs
E1_note: Existing baseline family is retained; E1 random-sampling parameters require separate freezing before any new effect experiment.
remaining_research: newly frozen confirmatory protocol if warranted
